g.text: Boundary choice changes the household profile
Source: ACS 2020-2024, B25003 / B11005 / B19001. Error bars: 90% MOE using 80 SDR replicates.
These are overlapping statistical geographies, not five independent communities. Sampling MOE does not measure boundary bias.
